source_verification_receipts.locator: PDF p. 15, Appendix F.2 Proposition 10 and Appendix G
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Proposition 10 defines the deviation score as a sum of pairwise precision-difference ranks and asserts that an observational context is exactly its argmin; Appendix G says rank-at-most-two is necessary but not sufficient and leaves a membership test to future work.

Theorem 4.1 assumes a fixed number of components and recovers mixture parameters under effective interventions and faithfulness; Corollary 4.1.1 additionally assumes samples from the observational distribution and I-faithfulness to identify the I-MEC.

The paper studies two designated observational/interventional SEMs under soft interventions, identifies targets through sparse precision differences, and gives the displayed Lasso-type precision-difference estimator in equation (6).
UT-IGSP assumes access to purely observational data and uses direct I-faithfulness to identify unknown intervention targets and the I-MEC.

Theorem 1.1 gives dimension-polynomial clustering for centered Gaussian mixtures under pairwise total-variation separation of the form 1 minus a weight-dependent quantity; it is not an operator-norm covariance-tail theorem for perfect-surgery mixtures.
